admire-pro.quote: ADMIRE® PRO Systemic Protectant EPA Reg. No. 264-827
admire-pro.note: Resolves allowlist question: PPLS 264-827 (Bayer CropScience LLC, Active) primary name is 'GAUCHO 550 SC INSECTICIDE' with alternate brand name 'ADMIRE PRO SYSTEMIC PROTECTANT'. The quote is from the EPA-accepted Admire Pro supplemental foliar label (2011) under the same number; latest full label 000264-00827-20190917.pdf is written under the Gaucho 550 SC brand.

anthem-maxx.quote: F9310-7 (ABN: Anthem Maxx Herbicide) For preplant burndown/ preemergence, preplant incorporated and postemergence weed c
anthem-maxx.note: FMC, Active. PPLS alternate brand names: ANTHEM MAXX HERBICIDE, ANTHEM NXT HERBICIDE. The newer 2026 label files print only F9310-7; 279-3450 is plain Anthem (different product).

aza-direct.quote: Produced For: EPA Reg. No. 71908-1-10163 Gowan Company
aza-direct.note: Supplemental distributor number (parent 71908-1 NeemAzal T/S 1.2 EC, Coromandel International; distributor 10163 = Gowan). Plugin names Gowan, so the distributor number applies. PPLS search 'Aza-Direct' returns 71908-1-10163 AZA-DIRECT, Active since 2018-12-04; PPLS holds no label PDF for the distributor number, so the Gowan-hosted label (rev 01-R1218) is the source.

belay.quote: Contains 2.13 lbs active ingredient per gallon EPA Reg. No. 59639-150
belay.note: Resolves allowlist question: PPLS 59639-150 (Valent U.S.A. LLC, Active) is titled 'V-10170 2.13SC INSECTICIDE' with alternate brand names 'BELAY INSECTICIDE' and 'CLUTCH SC INSECTICIDE'. Quote is from the Belay Insecticide label (code 2018-BEL-0001-1681-L) linked from valent.com/products/belay-insecticide. Other Belay brands exist (Belay 50 WDG 59639-152, Belay 16 WSG 59639-153) but are dry; the plugin's fl-oz rate matches the liquid Belay Insecticide.

bravo-weather-stik.quote: Bravo®720 (Alternate Brand Name: Bravo Weather Stik
bravo-weather-stik.note: Bravo Weather Stik is an alternate brand of Bravo 720, originally 50534-188 (GB Biosciences/Syngenta). PPLS: 50534-188 transferred to 66222-276 (Makhteshim Agan of North America / ADAMA) on 2017-09-18; 66222-276 is Active and PPLS lists altbrandname 'BRAVO WEATHERSTIK'. No Syngenta-held active registration remains (Syngenta supplemental 50534-188-100 is Inactive). Plugin displayName still says Syngenta.

captan-80wdg.quote: GROUP M4 FUNGICIDE CAPTAN 80 WDG [Alternate Brand Name: Captan 80 WDG Fungicide] A Fungicide for Plant Disease Control
captan-80wdg.note: Plugin names Arysta: Arysta's Captan 80 WDG was 66330-29 (label above, Arysta letterhead p1); PPLS reg record shows 66330-29 transferred to UPL NA as 70506-445 on 2021-05-26 (Active). 66222-58-51036, 103591-32 (Prism) etc. are other registrants' products. PPLS lists no label file under 70506-445 yet, so the quoted label is the last 66330-29 file. Plugin names Arysta; Arysta was acquired by UPL and its 66330-29 registration transferred to UPL as 70506-445 on 2021-05-26.

engenia.quote: Engenia is a soluble liquid (SL). EPA Reg. No. 7969-507
engenia.note: Resolves the allowlist ambiguity: of the three PPLS 'Engenia Herbicide' records, only 7969-507 is Active (BASF, label accepted 2026-02-06, RUP, labeling expires 2028-02-06); 7969-345 and 7969-472 are Inactive. Jugs from the earlier registrations will carry the old numbers.

flint-extra.note: PPLS product name is GEM 500 SC FUNGICIDE (Bayer CropScience LLC, Active); FLINT EXTRA is a registered alternate brand name (PPLS altbrandname 'FLINT EXTRA'). Resolves allowlist note: 264-777 is plain Flint (50WG), not Flint Extra.

gramoxone-sl-3.quote: Gramoxone® 3LB [Alternate Brand Name: Gramoxone® SL 3.0] HERBICIDE A Weed, Grass, and Harvest Aid Desiccant/Defoliant Herbicide
gramoxone-sl-3.note: Resolves the allowlist ambiguity: Gramoxone SL 3.0 is a label-printed alternate brand of Gramoxone 3LB (Syngenta, Active). Gramoxone SL 2.0 is a separate product.

indar-2f.quote: Group FUNGICIDE Enable® 2F [Alternate Brand Name: Indar® 2F] Fungicide Active Ingredient fenbuconazole ... 23.5%
indar-2f.note: Resolves the allowlist question: the federal Enable 2F label (Corteva, Active) carries Indar 2F as an alternate brand name (also on container page p6); PPLS search also lists 'INDAR 2F' as alt brand of 62719-416. The MI090002 etc. entries are 24(c) SLNs.

kocide-3000-o.quote: MANUFACTURED FOR: Certis USA LLC ... EPA Reg. No. 91411-11-70051 ... FOR ORGANIC PRODUCTION Dry Flowable
kocide-3000-o.note: Certis supplemental distributor number (PPLS search: '91411-11-70051 Kocide 3000-O' Active). Base registration 91411-11 is COSACO LLC product KX-002 with alternate brand name KOCIDE 3000-O (PPLS, Active; label 091411-00011-20180312 p.3 'KX-002 ABN: Kocide 3000-O'). Plugin names Certis, so the supplemental number is used. Resolves allowlist note: plugin's candidates 91411-2 / 352-662 are plain Kocide 3000.

lannate-lv.quote: GROUP 1A INSECTICIDE Lannate® LV INSECTICIDE {[Alternate Brand Name:}[ Lannate® LV] Water Soluble Liquid ... EPA Reg. 61842-55
lannate-lv.note: Resolves allowlist ambiguity: 352-384 (Corteva) is not a separate live product. PPLS transfer_history shows it moved to 61842-55 (Tessenderlo Kerley, Inc.) on 2023-01-12, and 61842-55 is the only Active record. The plugin name says 'Corteva', but Corteva no longer holds the registration, so the display name/notes should drop Corteva. Newest file 20250729 has unreadable fonts, so the quote comes from the 2024-10-10 label.

liberty-ultra.quote: BASF Agricultural Solutions US LLC ... Alternate Brand Names: Liberty ® ULTRA Herbicide, Liberty ® ULTRA, Noventa® ULTRA, Noventa® ULTRA Herbicide
liberty-ultra.note: Base label name 'BASF L-Glufosinate-Ammonium 211'; Liberty ULTRA is a label-printed alternate brand name. PPLS status Active (BASF). Resolves the prior 'no PPLS match' reason.

me-too-lachlor-ii.quote: METOLACHLOR GROUP 15 HERBICIDE Me-Too-LachlorTM II Herbicide Jan 04, 2023 19713-549
me-too-lachlor-ii.note: Resolves the allowlist ambiguity: PPLS now titles 19713-549 'DREXEL ME-TOO-LACHLOR II HERBICIDE' (Active, Drexel); 19713-548 is plain 'Drexel Me-Too-Lachlor' (86.4%), and 19713-554/555/556 are the V/IV/III products. EPA letter p1: 'Product Name: Drexel Me-Too-Lachlor II Herbicide EPA Registration Number: 19713-549'.

mustang-maxx.matchedTitle: F9114 EC INSECTICIDE (ABN: MUSTANG MAXX INSECTICIDE)
mustang-maxx.quote: F9114 EC Insecticide [ABN: Mustang Maxx Insecticide] EPA Reg. No. 279-3426
mustang-maxx.note: Resolves the open allowlist question: the development-code title 'F9114 EC' carries Mustang Maxx as its alternate brand name (ABN) on the label itself; PPLS name search also lists 'MUSTANG MAXX INSECTICIDE' under 279-3426. Registrant FMC Corporation, status Active. Zeta-cypermethrin 9.15% matches the plugin AI.

permit.quote: HALOSULFURON-METHYL GROUP 2 HERBICIDE Permit® Herbicide PERMIT is a selective herbicide for control of listed broadleaf weeds and nutsedge
permit.note: PPLS 81880-2 'PERMIT' Active; 2025 amendment letter: 'change of primary brand name to PERMIT'. Registrant is Canyon Group LLC, label p3 'Produced For: Canyon Group LLC. C/O Gowan Company, LLC' - matches the plugin's Gowan attribution. Label covers 'CORN, FIELD AND FIELD CORN GROWN FOR SEED 2/3 - 1 1/3' oz/acre (p10). Not Permit Plus (81880-26).

quadris-flowable.quote: EPA Reg. No. 100-1098 ... Quadris Flowable Fungicide is a member of Syngenta’s Plant Performance™ product line
quadris-flowable.note: PPLS master brand for 100-1098 is Abound Flowable Fungicide; PPLS lists 'QUADRIS FLOWABLE FUNGICIDE' as an alternate brand (Active, Syngenta). The Syngenta Quadris container label (SCP 1098B-L2W 1218) prints EPA Reg. No. 100-1098 (p1). Quadris Top/Opti/Xtra are different registrations.

roundup-powermax-3.quote: MASTER LABEL FOR EPA REG. NO. 524-659 Primary Brand Name: MON 301108 Herbicide Alternate Brand Names: Roundup PowerMAX 3 Herbicide
roundup-powermax-3.note: Resolves the allowlist question: the label names Roundup PowerMAX 3 as the alternate brand of MON 301108 (524-659, Bayer). PPLS transfer history: 524-659 moved from Bayer CropScience to Ruveon, LLC on 2026-01-14 and is now carried as 105211-118 (Active, product name 'MON 301108 Herbicide', PPLS search alt name 'ROUNDUP POWERMAX 3 HERBICIDE'). Plugin names Bayer, so the Bayer number is used; jugs sold under Ruveon will show 105211-118. Registration transferred Bayer -> Ruveon, LLC on 2026-01-14 (now 105211-118 in PPLS); kept 524-659 because the plugin names Bayer, and jugs in circulation carry it.

sivanto-prime.quote: SIVANTO™ 200 SL [ABN: SIVANTO™ prime] EPA Reg. No. 264-1141
sivanto-prime.note: Resolves allowlist ambiguity: 'Sivanto prime' is an alternate brand name (ABN) of Sivanto 200 SL, 264-1141 (Bayer CropScience LLC, Active). PPLS altbrandnames for 264-1141 are 'SIVANTO PRIME' and 'SIVANTO PRIME 200 SL'. Sivanto 400 SL/HL (264-1198) is a different, 3.34 lb/gal product.

topsin-m-wsb.quote: THIOPHANATE-METHYL GROUP 1 FUNGICIDE TOPSIN® M WSB THIOPHANATE-METHYL FUNGICIDE IN WATER SOLUBLE BAGS 70% Wettable Powder
topsin-m-wsb.note: Resolves allowlist: PPLS shows 73545-16 (Nisso TM) transferred into 8033-125 (Nippon Soda, Active) on 2013-04-30, so 8033-125 is the current registration. Plugin names UPL: PPLS search lists UPL's supplemental 8033-125-70506 'TOPSIN M WSB' (Active) but PPLS has no label file for it, so the primary number is proposed.

valor-sx.quote: Valor® Herbicide is a water dispersible granule containing 51% active ingredient.
valor-sx.note: PPLS record 59639-99 (Valent, Active) lists alternate brand names 'VALOR SX HERBICIDE' and 'VALOR(R) SX HERBICIDE' (also Chateau, Payload WDG); label body uses 'Valor Herbicide'. Valor SX = the WDG 51% flumioxazin; Valor EZ is a separate SC registration (59639-127/-221). Resolves the prior 'Valor vs Valor SX' reason.

warrant.quote: FOR EPA REG. NO. 524-591 Registered Brand Names: Primary Brand Name: MON 63410 Herbicide Alternate Brand Name: WARRANT® Herbicide
warrant.note: Resolves the allowlist question: the master label names WARRANT as the alternate brand of MON 63410 (Bayer CropScience, Active, no transfers). PPLS search also lists 524-591 as 'WARRANT HERBICIDE'. Not Warrant Ultra (524-620, acetochlor + fomesafen).

revus.statement: Syngenta Revus technical bulletin: rainfast within 1 hour once spray has dried

merivon.statement: BASF Merivon technology sheet: rainfast 1 hour

pristine.statement: BASF Pristine technology sheet: rainfast 1 hour

presidio-fluopicolide.statement: Presidio label: foliar sprays are rainfast 2 hours after application

cevya-mefentrifluconazole.statement: Cevya label: rainfast 1 hour after the application has dried

quintec-quinoxyfen.statement: Quintec label: when applied alone, rainfast 1 hour after application

previcur-flex-propamocarb.statement: Bayer Previcur Flex product bulletin: rainfast 30 minutes after application

acramite-bifenazate.quote: This product is moderately toxic to bees and other pollinating insects exposed to direct treatment or to residues in/on blooming crops or weeds. ... Do not apply this product while bees are foraging the treatment area.
acramite-bifenazate.note: Label says 'moderately toxic' (not in the mapping) -> mapped to the more protective 'toxic'. Only bee restriction is the foraging statement; no bloom prohibition found (grep bees|bloom|flower). Latest PPLS label for the product now registered as 70506-536 (UPL NA, transferred from 400-503 on 2021-06-09).

applaud-buprofezin.quote: (no bee or pollinator statement anywhere on the label)
applaud-buprofezin.note: Correction (was relatively-nontoxic/none from the active-ingredient table). The 71711-21 label is silent on bees, so the label supports only 'unknown'; the kernel treats unknown as hazardous (warn).

aza-direct.quote: ENVIRONMENTAL HAZARDS This pesticide is toxic to fish and aquatic invertebrates.
aza-direct.note: No bee/pollinator/bloom/foraging language anywhere on the Aza-Direct label (grep \bbees?\b|pollinat|forag: none; 'bloom' only in 'Waxy bloom'). Parent 71908-1 label (2020-01-27, 79 pp) also has no bee language.

azaguard.quote: ENVIRONMENTAL HAZARDS This pesticide is toxic to fish and aquatic invertebrates. For terrestrial uses: Do not apply directly to water
azaguard.note: AzaGuard label (70299-17) Environmental Hazards and directions contain no bee/pollinator/bloom language (grep 'bee|pollinat|bloom' across all 32 pages: no hits). Label silent -> unknown/none.

confirm-2f-tebufenozide.quote: (no bee or pollinator statement anywhere on the label)
confirm-2f-tebufenozide.note: Correction (was relatively-nontoxic/none from the active-ingredient table). The 8033-111 label is silent on bees, so the label supports only 'unknown'; the kernel treats unknown as hazardous (warn).

dimilin-2l.quote: Drift of this product onto beehives or off-site to pollinator attractive habitat can result in reducing immature bee viability.
dimilin-2l.note: Env. Hazards (p4): 'This pesticide is toxic to terrestrial juvenile insects'. Brood/immature-bee effect -> at least 'toxic' per brief. No do-not-apply-during-bloom or foraging restriction; label directs bloom-period uses (cotton first bloom through mid-bloom; nut crops 'bloom to petal fall'), so bloomRestriction 'none'.

envidor-spirodiclofen.quote: PROTECTION OF POLLINATORS Do not apply this product or allow it to drift to blooming crops or weeds if bees are visiting the treatment area. (p.4) ... For citrus (except lemon) in California, do not apply until petal fall is complete. (p.7)
envidor-spirodiclofen.note: Label has no bee-toxicity statement (grep 'toxic' only hits disposal) -> beeToxicity unknown. General restriction is foraging-only, but the crop-specific California citrus direction prohibits application until petal fall -> prohibited-during-bloom per brief rule ('on any crop'). Current label is under 10163-383 (Gowan; transferred from Bayer 264-831 on 2021-03-18).

grandevo-wdg.quote: This product is toxic to certain nontarget terrestrial arthropods. (p.5) ... This product temporarily repels honeybees, for up to 4 to 6 days after spraying. (p.7) ... Flowers, Bedding Plants and Ornamentals - ground application only to non-blooming plants (p.18)
grandevo-wdg.note: No explicit bee-toxicity statement: label says toxic to 'certain nontarget terrestrial arthropods' and that it repels honeybees 4-6 days; neither maps cleanly -> unknown (reviewer may choose 'toxic' as the more protective reading of the arthropod statement). Bloom: ornamentals section limits application to non-blooming plants -> prohibited-during-bloom per 'any crop' rule. No hour figure for residual toxicity (repellency 4-6 days is not toxicity).

kanemite-acequinocyl.quote: ENVIRONMENTAL HAZARDS This product is toxic to aquatic invertebrates such as Eastern oysters and mysid shrimp.
kanemite-acequinocyl.note: Label has no bee/pollinator/bloom language (grep bee|pollinat|bloom|hive|forag: no match). Only 'relatively harmless to most predacious mites and beneficial insects' (p7), which is not a bee statement.

majestene-nematicide.quote: To minimize potential exposure to bees and other pollinating insects, do not apply while bees are foraging. - Do not allow product to drift to blooming crops or weeds if bees are foraging.
majestene-nematicide.note: Label (84059-14 master, alternate brand MAJESTENE) makes no bee-toxicity statement (Env. Hazards p5 only refers to Directions for Use), so beeToxicity=unknown. Only foraging-time language, no bloom prohibition -> dusk-to-dawn-only.

met52-ec-metarhizium.note: Last PPLS label bearing the Met52 EC brand (reg then 70127-10, now 64137-33). No bee/pollinator/bloom language on it, nor on the current Lalguard M52 OD label (064137-00033-20260528.pdf).

movento.quote: This product is potentially toxic to honey bee larvae through residues in pollen and nectar, but not to adult honeybees. (p.5) ... Do not apply this product within 10 days prior to bloom, during bloom, or until petal fall is complete. (p.15)
movento.note: Brood/larvae toxicity statement -> at least 'toxic' per brief (label says not toxic to adults). Many crop sections prohibit bloom application: seed onions/leeks/chives 'do not apply 4 months prior to bloom, during bloom or until after petal fall' (p.13); p.15 crop '10 days prior to bloom, during bloom, or until petal fall'; pome/stone/tree nut 'do not apply prior to petal-fall' (p.8). -> prohibited-during-bloom.

oberon-spiromesifen.quote: ENVIRONMENTAL HAZARDS This pesticide is toxic to fish and aquatic invertebrates. Do not contaminate surface water through spray drift.
oberon-spiromesifen.note: Oberon 2SC label makes no bee/brood toxicity statement and no bloom or foraging restriction. Page 6 has only the generic pollinator best-management advisory ('applying pesticides at twilight and at night when pollinators are less likely foraging' offered as an example BMP, not a directive). -> unknown/none. Not marked silent because generic pollinator-BMP text is present.

pfr-97-isaria.quote: ENVIRONMENTAL HAZARDS For outdoor, non-greenhouse use, do not apply when bees are actively foraging.
pfr-97-isaria.note: Label for PFR-97 20% WDG (EPA 70051-19, Certis USA). No bee-toxicity statement, so unknown. The only restriction is on foraging, so dusk-to-dawn-only. The newest file (2020-10-28) is a hemp supplemental with no bee text, so the 2020-02-04 full label was used.

portal-xlo.quote: Minimum Honey Bee Toxicity Fenpyroximate is practically nontoxic to bees through acute contact and acute oral exposure when applied to listed crops according to the label directions.
portal-xlo.note: Label explicitly states practically nontoxic to bees; no bloom or foraging restriction found (grep bloom|forag|flowering|pollinat: none).

sivanto-prime.quote: Highly toxic to adult Megachile rotundata (alfalfa leafcutting bee) via direct contact exposure. Do not apply to foliage when managed alfalfa leafcutting bees are foraging in the treatment area.
sivanto-prime.note: Correction (was relatively-nontoxic/none from the AI table). Label also: 'Toxic to adult bees in laboratory studies via oral exposure. Not toxic to honey bees or bumble bees through contact exposure.' Stricter class taken.

spear-lep.quote: Environmental Hazards: For terrestrial uses: Do not apply directly to water, or to areas where surface water is present
spear-lep.note: Master label (then EPA 88847-6, Vestaron) listing Spear-Lep as alternate brand (p24). No bee/pollinator/bloom language anywhere (grep bee|pollinat|bloom|hive|forag).

velum-prime-fluopyram-nematicide.quote: ENVIRONMENTAL HAZARDS For terrestrial uses: DO NOT apply directly to water, or to areas where surface water is present
velum-prime-fluopyram-nematicide.note: No bee/pollinator/bloom-restriction language anywhere on the 64-page label (grep 'bee|pollinat' no hits; 'bloom' only in 'coverage of foliage, bloom, and fruit'). Label silent -> unknown/none.

venerate-xc.quote: To minimize potential exposure to bees and other pollinating insects, do not apply while bees are foraging.
venerate-xc.note: Also 'Do not allow product to drift to blooming crops or weeds if bees are foraging.' No bee toxicity class stated and no bloom prohibition, only a foraging restriction.
